intro.data: Two components are offered at each object, both correctly typed List → Optional. But only one family is natural: headOrDefault sneaks in a default and breaks on the empty list. Pick the components so every naturality square commutes.
intro.alchemy: Two components are offered at each material, both correctly typed Batch → Trace. Only one family is natural: the spare-injecting one breaks on the empty batch. Pick the components so every square commutes.
intro.spellcraft: Two components are offered at each essence, both correctly typed Swarm → Echo. Only one family is natural: the conjuring one breaks on the empty swarm. Pick the components so every square commutes.
intro.abstract: Two candidate components α_A are offered at each object, both F(A) → G(A). Only one family satisfies naturality. Choose it.

goal.data: Choose the component at each object so map-then-head equals head-then-map.
goal.alchemy: Choose the component at each material so the naturality square commutes.
goal.spellcraft: Choose the component at each essence so the naturality square commutes.
goal.abstract: Choose components making α_B ∘ F(f) = G(f) ∘ α_A.

afterSuccess.data: Only safeHead commutes: mapping then taking the head equals taking the head then mapping. headOrDefault fails on the empty list — the default doesn't transform under f. Correct types are not enough; the squares must commute.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Only Sample commutes. The spare-injecting component fails on the empty batch — the spare doesn't transform under f. Correct types are not enough; the squares must commute.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Only Catch commutes. The conjuring component fails on the empty swarm — the conjured one doesn't transform under f. Correct types are not enough; the squares must commute.
afterSuccess.abstract: Only the natural family commutes; the typed-but-broken family fails the square. Correct typing is necessary but not sufficient.

reveal.summary: Naturality: for every f : A → B, α_B ∘ F(f) = G(f) ∘ α_A. A family of correctly-typed components is a natural transformation only when every such square commutes.
reveal.moreFormal: This puzzle checks naturality for real: the engine composes both ways around each square using D's composition table and compares. headOrDefault is well-typed but not natural.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: A polymorphic function is natural (a 'parametric' one); injecting a fixed default breaks parametricity.
